item.title: Viewport 0.4.0
item.description:
Notarized macOS release. Requires macOS 26 or later. The download contains the signed, notarized Viewport app.
## Inspector
A new inspector panel opens from the toolbar or **Inspect ▸ Show or Hide Inspector** (⌥⌘I).
- **Elements:** click a control in one pane and Viewport finds the same control in the other panes. It compares labels and roles, and flags missing accessible names and small tap targets. Works with Android devices, iOS Simulators and the web pane. - **Design:** layout grids, mockup overlays (overlay, difference or split), measurements in pt, dp or px, and a colour picker with a magnifier. - **Location:** set a location or play a GPX route on Simulators, Android emulators and the web pane together. - **Apps:** allow, deny or reset app permissions, and send test push notifications to Simulators. - **Network:** throttle Android emulator networks, go offline, and route panes through a debugging proxy such as Proxyman, Charles or mitmproxy.
## Open Link
**Open Link** (⇧⌘L) sends a URL or deep link to every visible pane at once, and keeps recent links and favourites.
## Screenshots
Screenshot annotations now include text labels and numbered steps. Click to place one, or drag to add a pointer line.
## Devices
- Text size now works on iOS Simulators as well as Android. - A new Contrast option turns increased contrast on or off on every device.
## Updates
Viewport checks quietly for a new version when it opens and shows an **Update available** button in the toolbar when there is one. **Check for Updates…** in the Viewport menu opens the Updates window, which checks again and offers to install.

item.title: Viewport 0.3.1
item.description:
Notarized macOS release. Requires macOS 26 or later. The download contains the signed, notarized Viewport app.
This release replaces 0.3.0, whose download could not be opened. macOS reported that Apple could not verify the app because of a packaging problem in the ZIP. The app itself was unchanged; 0.3.1 ships the same features in a correctly packaged archive.
## In-app updates
Viewport can now update itself. Open **Updates…** from the Viewport menu or the Settings menu in the toolbar to check for new versions, read release notes, and install. Automatic checking is optional and off until you turn it on. Installing always requires an explicit action, and the restart waits until any recording or Build & Play run has finished.
This is the first release with the updater, so existing users need to download this version manually once. Later releases can be installed from inside Viewport.
## Quitting
- Quitting while recording now asks whether to save or discard the recording. - Quitting is blocked while Build & Play is running or a recording is being saved, with a message explaining why.
